meta.title: Tenax Prop — REST API Standard (Request / Response Contract)
meta.purpose: Har API ka request aur response ISI standard mein banega. Postman collection bhi isi shape mein share karein taaki Flutter app ka ApiResponse<T> model bina change ke sabhi endpoints ke saath kaam kare.
meta.note: Flutter client (lib/core/network/api_response.dart) sirf { success, message, data } expect karta hai. Is contract se deviate mat karna.

conventions.money: Numbers as decimal (not string), currency alag field mein (e.g. amount: 104280.50, currency: "USD")
conventions.ids: String UUID/ID (JSON number overflow se bachne ke liye string preferred)
conventions.empty_data: data null ho sakta hai success par bhi (e.g. logout), list empty ho to [] bhejo, null nahi

body_rules: POST/PUT/PATCH ka body hamesha JSON object hoga (top-level array nahi).
Sabhi input fields validate honge; failure par 422 + errors object.
File upload ke liye multipart/form-data use hoga (JSON nahi).

response_standard.description: HAR response — success ya error — is envelope mein wrap hoga.

envelope.success: boolean — true agar request pass hui
envelope.message: string — user-friendly message (UI mein direct dikhaya ja sakta hai)
envelope.errors: object | null — sirf validation failure (422) par field-wise errors
envelope.meta: object | null — pagination / extra info (sirf list responses par)

error_standard.description: Error par bhi wahi envelope. success:false, message user ko dikhane layak, errors field-wise (validation ke liye).

password: Password must be at least 8 characters

body.message: You do not have permission to perform this action
Something went wrong. Please try again later

status_codes.201: Created — POST ne naya resource banaya
status_codes.403: Forbidden — token valid par permission nahi
status_codes.422: Unprocessable Entity — validation error (errors object bhejo)

authentication.usage: Login ke response mein access_token do. Client isko secure storage mein rakhega aur har protected request par Authorization: Bearer <token> header bhejega.

postman_setup_instructions.1_collection: Ek hi Postman Collection banao: 'Tenax Prop API'. Feature-wise folders banao: Auth, Account, Billing, KYC, Verification, Challenge, Competitions, Rewards, Trading Rules, Calculators, Downloads, FAQ, Economic Calendar, Certificates, Settings.
postman_setup_instructions.2_environment: Do environments banao: 'Dev' aur 'Prod'. Variables: base_url, access_token, refresh_token.
postman_setup_instructions.3_base_url_variable: Har request mein hardcode URL mat likhna — {{base_url}} use karo.
postman_setup_instructions.4_auth: Collection level par Authorization = Bearer {{access_token}} set karo. Login request ke Tests tab mein token ko environment mein save karo: pm.environment.set('access_token', pm.response.json().data.access_token);
postman_setup_instructions.5_examples: Har request par 'Save Response' se success aur error dono examples add karo (200 + 422/401), taaki frontend expected shape dekh sake.
postman_setup_instructions.6_naming: Request naam action-based: 'Login', 'Register', 'Get Profile', 'Update Profile', 'List Transactions'.
postman_setup_instructions.7_share: Collection + Environment export karke (ya Postman workspace share link) frontend ko do.
